edges.description: Edges between the returned nodes (and the start node).

nodes.description: Reached nodes, nearest first, then by id.

truncated.description: More nodes or edges matched than were returned.

TraversedNode.description: A node reached by a traversal.

depth.description: Fewest hops from the start node.

ttl_ms.description: Milliseconds from now until the key expires (positive).

weight.description: Share of replica reads, 0 to 1000 (0 takes it out of rotation).

Upload.description: A multipart or resumable upload session.

content_type.description: Content type of the finished object.

declared_sha256.description: Declared SHA-256 of the whole object.

declared_size.description: Declared total size (resumable uploads complete when it is reached).

checksum_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the whole object, verified on completion.

size.description: Total size, when known (required to auto-complete a resumable upload).

UpsertItem.description: One item to insert or replace.

id.description:
1 to 64 of `[A-Za-z0-9_-]`; generated when absent. An existing item
with this id is replaced completely.

metadata.description: JSON object, filterable with the filter language (`category = 'news'`).

text.description: Text for keyword search (the full-text side of hybrid search).

vectors.description: Vector per field name. Fields left out have no vector for this item.

items.description: 1 to 1000 items, written in one transaction.

created.description: Items that did not exist before.

UsageCharge.description: One FB-24 usage event charged in credits.

entry_id.description: The consumption entry (`null` when nothing could be charged).

shortfall.description: Credits the balance could not cover (FB-70 may bill them).

next.description: Pass as `after` for the next page (`null`: no more).

UsageEvent.description: An immutable usage record (FB-70 bills from these).

overage_units.description: Of which past a soft limit (billable overage).

units.description: Units (in-window plus pack units; gauges: the change).

next.description: Pass as `after` for the next page (`null`: no more).

UsageMeter.description: The counter of one feature of one subject in its current window.

carried_in.description: Rolled over from the previous window.

scope_key.description: Counter scope (`""` for the subject itself).

UsagePack.description: A usage pack of the catalog.

feature.description: Metered feature it adds units to.

UsageRequest.description: A quota check, consumption or reservation.

idempotency_key.description: Required for consume and reserve: a replay returns the first result.

scope_key.description:
Counter of a `user`, `team` or `resource` quota (default for `user`:
the caller).

subject.description:
Subject billed (default: the caller's subject; another subject needs
privileges or membership).

ttl_secs.description: Reservations: hold time in seconds (default 300, at most 86400).

UsageRun.description: What one run of the usage consumer did.

cursor.description: Cursor after the run (last usage event `seq` read).

events_charged.description: Events charged (priced and not charged before).

UsageSummary.description: Current usage of one feature of a subject.

carried_in.description: Rolled over from the previous window.

items.description: Number of items (that the caller's rule shows).

updated.description: Last change of the definition or the data.

VectorField.description: A vector field of a collection.

expansion_add.description: HNSW candidate list size while inserting.

expansion_search.description: HNSW candidate list size while searching.

quantization.description: Element type of the ANN index.

exact_threshold.description:
Searches over at most this many candidate vectors are exact (brute
force) instead of approximate. Default from the server configuration.

fields.description: Vector fields (at most 16; more can be added later).

source_collection.description:
The data collection the items are copied from, item id = record id
(FB-139). Searches and reads then re-check every item against that
collection's View rule as the caller, leave out the metadata keys the
caller may not read there, and refuse filters on them. Set at
creation only.

Verification.description: The DNS record that proves ownership.

expires_at.description: The token stops being accepted at this time (epoch ms).

files_checked.description: Files whose size and hash were checked.

oneOf.description: The manifest, when it could be read.

problems.description: Reasons the backup cannot be restored.

warnings.description: Things worth knowing that do not block a restore.

VersionConfig.description:
Everything about one version except the module itself. Stored as JSON in
`_forgebase_function_versions.config`; a rollback restores all of it.

env.description: Plain (non-secret) environment values, readable with the `env` capability.

fetch_hosts.description:
With `fetch`: hosts the function may call (`api.example.com`, or
`*.example.com` for subdomains). Empty = any public host.

language.description: The language it was written in.

runtime.description: How the version runs (`wasm` for versions deployed before FB-93).

active.description: Whether this is the active version.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the module (WebAssembly) or of the source (JavaScript, TypeScript), hex.

size.description: Size of the module or of the source in bytes.

VersionInfo.description:
One version of a function. `runtime` and `language` are part of the
flattened configuration.

VersionSource.description: The source of a JavaScript or TypeScript version.

Visibility.description: Who may read a bucket without an explicit grant.

Worker.description: A worker that registered or claimed jobs.

created_by.description: Who registered it (FB-146); `null`: registered before FB-146.

tenant.description: Tenant of the caller that registered it (FB-146); `null`: none.

failed_job_id.description: The job whose failure failed the workflow.

steps.description: Its jobs in creation order: steps, child jobs and compensations.

WorkflowDetail.description: A workflow with its jobs (the graph) and their timings.

WorkflowPage.description: A page of workflows, newest first.

WorkflowStep.description: A job of a workflow and the jobs it waits for.

depends_on.description: Ids of the jobs it waits for.

name.description: Step name (child jobs spawned by a step have none unless given).

WorkflowUpdate.description: A live update of a workflow, published on `jobs:<workflow id>`.

api_key.description: Service-account API key or personal access token (alternative to the bearer header).
api_key.name: X-API-Key

bearer.bearerFormat: access token (HS256 JWT), API key (fbk_…) or personal access token (fbp_…)
bearer.description: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Access tokens come from `/api/auth/login` and `/api/auth/refresh`; API keys and PATs carry scopes (`<area>:read|write[:<name>]`).

session_cookie.description: Browser session cookie from `/api/auth/login` with `cookie: true`; unsafe methods also need `X-CSRF-Token`.
session_cookie.name: fb_session

info.description: REST API over ForgeBase's SQL, collection and document engine. Errors are `{"error":{"code","message","request_id","details?"}}`. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <access token | API key | personal access token>`, `X-API-Key`, or the `fb_session` cookie (+ `X-CSRF-Token` on writes); see `/api/auth/*` and ADR-0004. Requests without credentials are anonymous and the authorizer decides; the `/api/v1` data API is versioned additively (ADR-0001 §6).
